{{Quote|Are you here looking for adventure or are you just going to walk around and smell the pretty flowers? If it is the prior then maybe you and I should talk. If it is the latter maybe you would do better on another world.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gurnst]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TFB" />}}
'''Task Force Bravo''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit that operated on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Kashyyyk has a problem. And that problem is that the natives don't seem to understand their defined role. That is why I am here. I am putting together a task force to wipe out that resistance. If you are interested I will swear you in right now and get you on the path of fortune and glory.|Colonel Gurnst, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TFB" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] was tired of losing valuable soldiers in trying to squelch the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Wookiee resistance]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] hired [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gurnst]] to assemble a mercenary troop in order to wipe out the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] resistance. Stationed in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], Colonel Gurnst formed Task Force Bravo and recruited many intrepid spacers visiting Kashyyyk to join the fight against the Wookiees. The mercenaries therefore attacked a Wookiee camp near the [[Bolotaur Beach]] and killed more than 15 Wookiee freedom fighters.<ref name="SWG:TFB" />
